name: Kaal
summary: Krrish 3's villain: a paralysed, telekinetic geneticist who breeds human-animal mutants and spreads a virus so he can sell the cure. Played by Vivek Oberoi.
origin: Kaal was born from a secret experiment Dr. Siddhant Arya ran on the captive Rohit Mehra, which makes him Rohit's biological son. He inherited Rohit's gifts as powerful telekinesis and telepathy, but he can move only his face and two fingers. Adopted by a wealthy man, whom he later kills, he builds Kaal Laboratories. There he creates Maanvars, human-animal mutants grown from his own DNA, and releases a virus so he can profit from the antidote, all while searching for a cure for his own body.
powers: Creates Maanvar mutants from his own DNA
Superhuman strength and mobility after taking Rohit's bone marrow

storyline.title: Born in Arya's lab
storyline.beat: An experiment by Dr. Siddhant Arya on the imprisoned Rohit Mehra creates Kaal, a hugely gifted mind in a body that barely moves.

storyline.title: A plague for profit
storyline.beat: Kaal's mutants spread a virus, first in Namibia and then in Mumbai, while Kaal waits to sell the cure.

storyline.title: The Kaya gambit
storyline.beat: His shapeshifting agent Kaya takes Priya's place while Priya is held in his lab, and Kaal plans to use Krrish's unborn child to cure himself.

storyline.title: Stolen strength
storyline.beat: Kaal cures himself with Rohit's bone marrow, kills Kaya for betraying him and appears to kill Krrish.

storyline.title: The final fall
storyline.beat: Rohit sacrifices himself to revive Krrish, who returns and destroys Kaal.

gossip.text: Chitrangada Singh was announced as a mutant and left, and Jacqueline Fernandez signed and backed out, before Kangana Ranaut took the part of Kaal's shapeshifter Kaya.
Critics claimed Krrish 3's domestic collections were inflated by around 60 crore rupees.
Hrithik Roshan missed the first shooting schedule because of a back injury, so filming began in December 2011 with Vivek Oberoi, Kangana Ranaut and Priyanka Chopra.
Kaal is an alien, like Jadoo.
gossip.truth: He is human: Rohit's son, created through Dr. Arya's experiment.

gossip.text: On Rotten Tomatoes, Krrish 3 sits at 71 percent from 17 critics, who praised the cast and effects but not the originality.

quiz.q: What are Kaal's human-animal mutants called?
quiz.why: Maanvar mixes the Hindi words for human and animal.
Vivek Oberoi played the paralysed mastermind.

quiz.q: How does Krrish finally defeat Kaal?
quiz.why: Krrish uses Rohit's solar experiment pen to focus sunlight on Kaal.

quiz.q: Where does Kaal's virus first spread?
quiz.why: The deadly virus spreads in Namibia before reaching Mumbai.

theme.tagline: His body barely moves. His mind never stops.

timeline.title: Diwali debut
timeline.note: Krrish 3 opens on 1 November 2013 for the Diwali weekend, bringing a paralysed genius with telekinesis and an army of mutants.

timeline.title: Kaya's switch
timeline.note: His shapeshifting agent Kaya takes Priya's place. When she turns on him, Kaal kills her.

timeline.title: Destroyed by Krrish
timeline.note: Rohit gives his life to revive his son, and the returning Krrish finishes Kaal for good.

timeline.title: A record-setting film
timeline.note: Krrish 3 ends as the highest-grossing Indian superhero film, at about 393 crore rupees worldwide.

facts.text: Vivek Oberoi's metal Kaal suit weighed about 28 kilograms and took 7 or 8 people two to three hours to put on him.
Rakesh Roshan rewrote his script because the first version was too similar to the Hollywood film Spider-Man 3.
Kaal can move only his face and his index fingers, but his mind and his telekinetic and telepathic powers make him one of the most dangerous people in the story.
Maanvar, the name for his mutants, blends two Hindi words: maanav for human and jaanvar for animal.
The Maanvars are made by fusing human and animal serum: Striker uses a frog's tongue, Rhino Man a horn, Cheetah Woman speed and claws, Scorpion Woman a stinger in her plait.
Kaal is Krishna's biological brother, since both are Rohit Mehra's sons, and Hrithik Roshan plays both Rohit and Krishna.
In the finale Kaal wraps himself in a steel body using his magnetic powers and flies to Mumbai to threaten its people.
Kaal's chameleon-like agent Kaya is made by fusing a woman's serum with a chameleon's, which is how she can take on anyone's shape. She later falls for Krishna after posing as Priya.
Some Krrish 3 scenes were shot in the Alps, and the Sphinx Observatory in the Alps is shown on screen as Kaal's laboratory.
Kaal is also an ordinary Hindi word: it means time or an era, and in Hindu usage it can also mean death.
Among Kaal's Maanvars, Ant Man is a human-ant hybrid who can lift objects up to 100 times his own body weight.
Every visual-effects action sequence in Krrish 3 was revised 40 to 50 times, and the very last effects shot arrived on 22 October 2013, ten days before release.
Kaal's virus does not affect Rohit, Krishna or Priya. Rohit notices this and then makes the antidote from Krishna's blood.
Dr. Arya's experiment was meant to make a copy of Rohit, but he got a disabled child instead and left him at an orphanage, where a wealthy family adopted him.
Rakesh Roshan wanted a villain as powerful as the hero. Talks with Ajay Devgn and Shah Rukh Khan fell through before Vivek Oberoi was cast as Kaal.
Vivek Oberoi said Kaal was the opposite of his own friendly nature, and that showing the character's hatred of humanity through his eyes alone was hard.
Kaal plans to make Priya give birth early so that he can use her baby's bone marrow to cure his disability.
Kaal creates the Maanvars as test subjects in his hunt for a cure for his own body, but the experiments fail to help him.
Cheetah Woman, one of Kaal's Maanvars, is said to match no human for speed, and she can teleport like a ghost.
Principal photography began on 1 December 2011 with Vivek Oberoi, Kangana Ranaut and Priyanka Chopra, while Hrithik Roshan missed the first schedule with a back injury.
Dr. Alok Sen, a scientist at Kaal's company who wants to reveal what he knows about the virus, is silenced by Kaal's agent Kaya.

kidSummary: Kaal is the clever villain of the film Krrish 3. His body barely moves, but his mind can move things from afar. He makes animal-human mutants called Maanvars and spreads a virus so he can sell the cure, until Krrish stops him.

story.title: A mind in a still body
story.text: Kaal can move only his face and two fingers, but his mind is full of power and he runs his own laboratory.

story.title: The Maanvars
story.text: He makes mutants that mix human and animal, like a frog man, a cheetah woman and a rhino man.

story.title: A virus for profit
story.text: Kaal spreads a virus on purpose so that people will pay him for the cure.

story.title: A shapeshifting helper
story.text: His agent Kaya can look like anyone, and she even pretends to be Priya.

story.title: Face to face with Krrish
story.text: Kaal and Krrish fight over Mumbai, and Krrish wins by focusing sunlight with Rohit's invention.
